snapshot.name: flying_shark.z80
snapshot.note: Flying Shark (1987)(Firebird).z80, the 48K loader snapshot at its PAUSE 0 with the game packed and the real loading screen shown; the archive has no 128K release.

recordings.name: s1.rzx
recordings.role: Clean scripted Kempston play from the loading screen, 3,000 frames. The broken builds and the ABI cases use its first 1,300 frames.

recordings.name: full1.rzx
recordings.role: Clean scripted Kempston play: title, play, deaths, game over, name entry and a new game, 9,019 frames.

recordings.name: deep1.rzx
recordings.role: A test fixture with an infinite lives poke, scripted Kempston play into later scenery, 24,026 frames; coverage, not clean play. Not in the verify list: it starts mid-game (PC FDFD, after the unpack), not from the snapshot, so the ROM path check's tail and printer buffer model, which assumes the build's own start, does not fit it (the game's own data sits at the tail's address there). Replayed whole with auto --rzx on this tree: IDENTICAL, every ROM byte as recorded.

verify.note: At every hook every register with R, all 48K RAM (stack too) and every port write in order against the original; the Layer 2 picture against an independent model read from the game's graphics at every flip, and the last figure's ink against the bitmap the blit wrote; ABI cases on s1's states and 14 broken builds. deep1 is replayed by hand (its role says why). Pace, soak, flicker, beam audit and the real loader are in games/flying_shark.md "Evidence".

status.title: Flying Shark
